title: Reduced pullback along a flat geometrically reduced morphism
statement: Let $h:Y\to S$ be a flat morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-flat-morphism]. Assume that for every field $K$ and every morphism $\operatorname{Spec}K\to S$ [def-weil-field, def-weil-affine-spectrum], the scheme $Y\times_S\operatorname{Spec}K$ [def-pc-fibre-product] is reduced [def-pc-reduced-scheme]. Then for every reduced locally Noetherian scheme $T$ [pqf-def-locnoeth] and every morphism $T\to S$, the ordinary fibre product $T\times_S Y$ is reduced. Neither morphism is assumed of finite type or of finite presentation.
